name: Design Expert
description: Reviews interfaces produced by AI tools and pushes back on the usual tells — placeholder typography, identical layouts above the fold — with a rule that a single generation does not count as finished. Aimed at founders shipping their own UI who lack a design lead to argue with.

official.title: Design Expert by Ashish
